sections.text: Code minification is a critical optimization step in modern web development. By removing whitespace, comments, and optional syntax tokens, minification can reduce file sizes by 20-60% without changing functionality. This directly translates to faster page loads, lower bandwidth costs, and improved user experience. HTML minification strips comments, collapses whitespace, and removes optional quotes. CSS minification removes comments and spaces around syntax tokens. JavaScript minification is the most sophisticated, handling variable renaming and dead code elimination in advanced tools.
